message: Command `cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh && echo "---" && find /workspace -name "*.a" -o -name "*.so" -o -name "wasm-objdump" 2>/dev/null | head -20` executed with exit code 0.
content:
mkdir build
cd build
cmake ..
cmake --build .
cd ..
for fuzzers in $(find $SRC -name '*_fuzzer.cc' | grep -v wasm_objdump_fuzzer); do
  fuzz_basename=$(basename -s .cc $fuzzers)
  $CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -I. -Ibuild   $fuzzers $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ./build/libwabt.a   -o $OUT/$fuzz_basename
done
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -I. -Ibuild /src/wasm_objdump_fuzzer.cc         ./src/binary-reader-objdump.cc $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ./build/libwabt.a         -o $OUT/wasm_objdump_fuzzer
---
